div.div:
1. Buyer view: origin, processing dates, status and drying variables only; no personal data, no full trace.
2. Transporter outbox keeps at least 7 days of 5-minute fixes (2,016); custody events are never dropped.
3. Codes are 80 random bits with a check symbol; any unknown code returns the same not found.
4. Solid = live call; dashed = physical handover, buffered step, audit or response.
